expectation_source: Rejection classes were authored independently from the atb-jcs-rfc8785-2 canonical-output-closed specification, not derived from implementation output. Every case must reject with number_out_of_policy.

cases.notes: 1e20 is finite binary64, but its fixed-notation canonical output 100000000000000000000 is a plain integer outside ±(2^53-1).
2^53 written with a fraction is not saved by the input plain-token cap; its canonical output is the plain integer 9007199254740992, one above the policy maximum.
2^60 written with a fraction canonicalises to a fixed-notation plain integer outside ±(2^53-1).
2^55 written with a fraction canonicalises to the fixed-notation plain integer 36028797018963970, inside [2^53, 1e21) and outside ±(2^53-1).
Negative 2^53 written with a fraction canonicalises to -9007199254740992, pinning the lower side of the [−1e21, −2^53] rejection interval.
1e16 canonicalises to 10000000000000000, a plain integer outside the policy bound.
2e16 canonicalises to 20000000000000000, a plain integer outside the policy bound.
1e19 canonicalises to 10000000000000000000, a plain integer outside the policy bound.
Plain 10^21 is rejected by the retained input plain-integer cap. This lexical asymmetry is intentional: 1e21 is accepted because its canonical output is exponential.
